initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-5170, but Jira records it as pre-applied through the StructureDefinition rework. Git history shows candidate StructureDefinition added in February 2015, Profile and ExtensionDefinition merged into StructureDefinition on 2015-03-01, and remaining Profile terminology in StructureDefinition element definitions cleaned up on 2015-03-09.

Current source defines baseDefinition, derivation, snapshot, and differential separately; current narrative lists different StructureDefinition uses and the Profiling page explains sparse differentials and snapshots. FHIR-3873 quotes the same ballot text in a comment but has a separate explicit-element-type resolution, so it was treated only as background.
